blocks.text: Thorlabs' honeycomb breadboards are made with the same advanced manufacturing and design methods used for our optical tabletops. We also offer solid aluminum breadboards, which provide a convenient and cost-effective platform for prototyping and optical experiments. Our imperial and metric breadboards range in size from $4\mathrm{~x~}6$ to 6'x 4' and 100 mm x 150 mm to 2000 mm x 1250 mm, respectively.
